stories.title: Ulta Beauty brings back Mrs. Claus with Selena Gomez and Tate McRae
stories.summary: Ulta Beauty's holiday campaign returns Mrs. Claus, played by Sandra Gray, for a second season with pop stars Selena Gomez and Tate McRae, both of whom founded beauty brands sold at Ulta. Tamara Group created it and Nema Vand directed. Both stars also stock the shelves.

stories.title: Deconstruct tests its serum on oily skin before advertising it
stories.summary: Skincare brand Deconstruct launched an 'Oily Skin Tested' campaign built on product trials with participants chosen from over 6,000 registrations in South India. It centres on its Niacinamide Clearing Serum and runs across digital and social media. Founder Malini Adapureddy stressed ingredients and texture.

stories.title: Lenovo sets its new tablet to a Broadway-style musical
stories.summary: Kinnect has made a campaign for the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 featuring actor Abhay Varma, built on Lenovo's 'Damn the Odds' platform. The film uses a Broadway-inspired musical narrative. It is Kinnect's first integrated mainline campaign for Lenovo, covering creative and production.

stories.title: Amul launches a Rs 80 high-protein snack
stories.summary: Amul launched High Protein Cubes, a savoury snack with 25 g of protein and 150 calories in a 38 g pack, priced at Rs 80 on the Amul Shop app and website. Each comes with a tastemaker sachet in flavours including Peri Peri and Korean Kimchi.

stories.title: Instamart dresses a man as a chandelier for Diwali
stories.summary: Instamart's in-house team made a Diwali film in which a husband returning from a late-night party appears wearing a crystal chandelier as an outfit, seemingly on low battery. It ends with the line 'Diwali decor and more, only on Instamart.' The décor delivered itself.

stories.title: Rajnigandha's Diwali film brings a neighbourhood's rituals back
stories.summary: Rajnigandha's Diwali campaign, conceptualised by McCann and directed by Prashant Madan, follows a man who returns to his hometown, finds the festive spirit faded and revives old rituals until neighbours join in. It runs on television, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and OTT platforms.

stories.title: Anmol Biscuits makes a Diwali film about parents living alone
stories.summary: Anmol Biscuits' Diwali film 'Rishton Ka Uphaar', created by Meraqi Digital, follows parents coping after their children move away while presenting a positive picture to them. A son uses Anmol's Uphaar Box gift to make the festival special. It ties to the 'Har Pal Anmol' philosophy.

stories.title: Absolut Mixers and Ogilvy extend the Born Colourless idea
stories.summary: Absolut Mixers released a new film for its Born Colourless philosophy about moving beyond labels and biases, conceptualised with Ogilvy India and directed by Bharat Sikka. Composer Sneha Khanwalkar scored it. The idea earlier ran through the Absolut Creative Commune and a nationwide mural initiative.

stories.title: CP PLUS signs Ranveer Singh to sell security cameras
stories.summary: Surveillance company CP PLUS appointed actor Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador to raise awareness of intelligent security solutions for homes, businesses and public infrastructure. The association will support its messaging about domestically manufactured products.

stories.title: Hathi Edible Oil signs Anupam Kher and refreshes its packs
stories.summary: Hathi Edible Oil, a brand dating to 1912 from B. P. Oil Mills, appointed actor Anupam Kher as brand ambassador. The move coincides with new packaging across its mustard, groundnut and soybean oils, with Kacchi Ghani Mustard Oil remaining its flagship.

stories.title: Cricketer Mohit Sharma becomes an AI startup's ambassador and investor
stories.summary: Former India bowler Mohit Sharma has joined AI company Kyvex as brand ambassador and investor as it expands in consumer AI and Physical AI. Sharma, who played 26 ODIs and eight T20Is, is the Chennai Super Kings bowling coach for IPL 2027.

stories.title: The Face Shop tells festive India to do skincare first
stories.summary: The Face Shop's festive campaign 'Glow Before You Go' places Korean skincare routines before pujas, Diwali gatherings and parties. It runs on a hero film, influencer content and a social initiative around the line 'Before I go to the puja, glow', plus a retail activation.

stories.title: Burger King India moves its value deals into its app
stories.summary: Restaurant Brands Asia's India revenue rose 24.1% to Rs 705.6 crore in Q2 FY27, with 14% same-store sales growth. Burger King India moved its '2 for Rs 79/99' offers to its app, where frequency rose 7%, and delivery reached 46% of the mix.

stories.title: SharkNinja signs a five-year McLaren deal to keep F1 fans
stories.summary: SharkNinja got a lift when its products appeared in Brad Pitt's F1 film, but the buzz faded, said Laura Dyer, its svp of global brand and partnerships. Its answer is a five-year McLaren sponsorship, Digiday reports. Some fans only then learned Shark and Ninja are one company.

stories.title: DOMS lets a girl choose her own future in a festive film
stories.summary: DOMS Industries' festive film follows Tara at a family gathering, where relatives give her DOMS gifts reflecting their hopes for her, from businesswoman to art or architecture. The film argues children need freedom to discover their own dreams rather than inherit relatives' expectations.

stories.title: WPP hires McCann's global CEO Tyler Turnbull to run WPP Creative
stories.summary: Tyler Turnbull will join WPP as CEO of WPP Creative in early 2027, succeeding Jon Cook. He is currently global CEO of McCann. WPP CEO Cindy Rose called him a world-class leader with the ambition and creative conviction to lead the creative business's next chapter.

stories.title: ASCI finds all 60 supplement ads it reviewed broke its code
stories.summary: The Advertising Standards Council of India found every one of the 60 nutraceutical ads it reviewed from July to September violated its code, MediaNama reports. None of the 31 advertisers that contested could substantiate claims. ASCI cannot fine the 32 brands, only recommend changes.

stories.title: Škoda talks about cows and drunk ants to sell the Slavia
stories.summary: This week's festive ads included Titan, Dabur Real and P-TAL films on family and tradition, and a Flipkart Minutes Halloween horror miniseries, BestMediaInfo reports. BBH India's 'Says It All.' campaign for the new Škoda Slavia opens on cows and drunk ants before reaching the car.

stories.title: Leo India's Aryaman Singh wins the One Show and Google AI challenge
stories.summary: Aryaman Singh, creative strategist at Leo India, won The One Show x Google AI Creative Challenge India Edition on 27 October and will represent India at the global finale in New York. Participants had as little as 10 minutes to turn surprise briefs into AI-made work.

stories.title: NYF Advertising Awards cuts fees for small agencies in its 70th year
stories.summary: New York Festivals Advertising Awards opened 2027 entries, marking 70 years since 1957. It introduced a $395 entry fee for agencies with fewer than 50 employees, expanded in-person judging with the 4A's and brought back its generative AI competition, GenJam.

stories.title: Robin Girdhar joins Publicis Groupe for media planning
stories.summary: Robin Girdhar has joined Publicis Groupe as director of media planning and buying after nearly two years at Times Internet in agency relationships. He was earlier at Interactive Avenues, where he led ITC's Sunfeast and Candyman, and at Motivator, GroupM.

stories.title: Continuum Media pushes its AI influencer platform Raise in India
stories.summary: Continuum Media is expanding in India under country head Joy Shrivastava with Raise, its AI-powered, performance-based influencer marketing platform. It uses data-driven predictions to reduce campaign risk and estimate outcomes, and has run campaigns for fintech brand Olyv, MediaNews4U reports.

stories.title: Influencer hires Conor Thompson for MENA brand partnerships
stories.summary: Creator marketing agency Influencer appointed Conor Thompson as executive director of brand partnerships, based in Dubai, with teams in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. He will help brands integrate creators from discovery to loyalty. MENA head Rabah Assaf said brands want culturally relevant work with measurable growth.

stories.title: Liquid I.V. hires Poppi's former CMO as marketer moves continue
stories.summary: Adweek's roundup of marketing leadership moves in the three weeks to 30 October includes Liquid I.V. hiring Poppi's former CMO Jenny Danzi to lead marketing, creative and consumer teams at the Unilever brand. Coursera appointed Amy Weisenbach as CMO.

stories.title: Instagram reportedly pays YouTubers up to $500,000 to post long videos
stories.summary: Instagram is reportedly offering select YouTube creators $50,000 to $500,000 to bring long-form videos to Features, its new horizontal-video format, ContentGrip reports. Features does not yet offer a standard YouTube-style ad revenue share. The cheque comes first and the revenue model later.

stories.title: How five platforms actually pay creators
stories.summary: After Instagram announced Features, The Publish Press reviewed five long-form platforms' revenue, creator pay and monetisation rules. It found qualifying does not guarantee a paycheck, and Substack is the only platform where anyone can start earning immediately with no thresholds attached.

stories.title: YouTube tests a $20 payout threshold for creators
stories.summary: YouTube is reportedly testing a lower minimum payment threshold of $20, against the current $100, for a limited number of creators in the US, India and Indonesia. The aim is to pay small earners sooner instead of making them wait until balances reach $100.

stories.title: YouTube gives spam-flagged creators 30 days to fix channels
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a programme, announced 29 October, that places eligible channels facing spam-policy termination under a 30-day lock instead. Owners cannot upload or comment during that time but can edit or delete offending videos, or appeal, to keep their channels.

stories.title: Amazon says creators influenced 42 million customers this year
stories.summary: Creator content influenced 42 million Amazon customers from January to September, 28 million of whom bought something, said Nidhi Thakkar, head of social commerce for emerging marketplaces. Amazon's Influencer Programme doubled to about two lakh creators and creator earnings rose 60%.

stories.title: YouTube ads cross $11 billion as viewers move to TV screens
stories.summary: YouTube's ad growth slowed in the third quarter of 2026 but still brought in more than $11 billion, parent Alphabet said, Social Media Today reports. Subscriptions are rising as more users watch on connected TVs. The full piece did not load for us.

stories.title: Bodycare builds a 700-strong micro-influencer network for its comeback
stories.summary: UK health and beauty retailer Bodycare is building its high street return around a 700-strong micro-influencer network, managed with commerce specialist PMC. It has reopened five stores, including Sheffield and Derby, and runs store operations through its own AI platform, AIMEE.

stories.title: Kenyan brands want sales, not followers, from influencers
stories.summary: Kenyan businesses face growing pressure to show returns from influencer campaigns as spending shifts from reach toward measurable sales, executives said at The Media Shift Kenya Live summit in Nairobi. Firms increasingly want creators who can show commercial contributions beyond follower and engagement figures.

stories.title: GIFTA panel says creators are consistently underestimated
stories.summary: At a panel by influencer gifting agency GIFTA, creator specialist Lottie Maddison said good creators and agencies see value at every stage of the exchange process. The agency cited YouGov data placing influencers among the top ten ways Americans discover new products.

stories.title: Amazon's ad business nears $20 billion a quarter
stories.summary: Amazon's advertising revenue came to almost $20 billion in Q3, up 12%, as total revenue reached $201.9 billion, Digiday reports. Ad revenue fell from $19.81 billion in Q2 because Prime Day moved into Q2 this year. Amazon is betting agentic AI will drive further growth.

stories.title: DoorDash's $17 billion Instacart deal creates a big retail ad rival
stories.summary: DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart for about $17 billion, which would bring their media networks under one parent if regulators approve. DoorDash said combined reach and cross-selling would be a win for advertisers. Adweek says it challenges Uber's $2 billion ad business.

stories.title: Walmart brings 3,000 shopper segments to Vibe streaming TV ads
stories.summary: Walmart now lets advertisers target self-serve connected TV campaigns on Vibe, which it acquired in August 2026, using its shopper audience segments. The rollout appeared in Vibe's 28 October update and Walmart Connect's announcement. It is the first major integration since the deal.

stories.title: Meta's rebuilt Andromeda engine scores over a billion ads a second
stories.summary: Meta said its redesigned Andromeda ad retrieval engine can assess over a billion eligible ads per second, in an engineering update on 28 October. The change sits beneath Facebook and Instagram campaigns alongside updates to its GEM model and a new system called GenRecs.

stories.title: WPP says Apple's Safari crackdown barely touches its data business
stories.summary: Apple's crackdown on cross-site identity matching keeps hitting the ad industry, but WPP CEO Cindy Rose told analysts it does not really affect its data solution, because it does not rely solely on identity matching, Digiday reports. That helps WPP's InfoSum case.

stories.title: Reddit stock plunges 29% as Google AI search hits traffic
stories.summary: Reddit shares fell 29.45% to $91.51 after it warned daily active unique visitors could drop by a low double-digit percentage in Q4 from about 130 million if referral traffic weakens. JPMorgan analysts pointed to Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode.

stories.title: Andy Jassy says AI shopping agents are still not great
stories.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said few customers are buying through third-party AI shopping assistants and the experience is still not great, nor more convenient than shopping directly. His comments come after Amazon blocked Meta's new AI assistant Muse, which he did not name.

stories.title: Meta and Google are both paying for AI with ads
stories.summary: Meta plans 2026 capital spending of $130 billion to $145 billion and announced a $95 billion fundraising plan for AI, while Google rebuilt Search around AI Mode and Gemini, Shattered.io writes. Both still depend on advertising to cover the bill.

stories.title: Taboola puts its AI answer engine on Motorola lockscreens
stories.summary: Taboola partnered with Motorola to put its DeeperDive answer engine on the lockscreen of select moto g phones, rolling out through 2026 and 2027 in the UK, Germany, Spain, France, Italy, Mexico and Argentina. Answers draw on publisher content using generative AI.

stories.title: Bluefish turns AI answer gaps into paid media briefs
stories.summary: Bluefish launched Paid Media Briefs, which turn gaps in Google and ChatGPT recommendations into suggested ad targeting, creative and landing pages, in its 27 October announcement. It generates briefs rather than buying inventory. ContentGrip notes campaign impact remains to be tested.

stories.title: B2B marketers now rank pipeline influence above leads
stories.summary: The B2BMX Insights 2026 Benchmark Report finds pipeline influenced is the top metric for 44% of B2B marketers, overtaking opportunities, MQLs and SALs. Revenue-based quotas rose from 25.33% in 2025 to 33.33% in 2026. The MQL had a good run.

stories.title: Cloudinary named a Gartner Leader in digital asset management
stories.summary: Cloudinary was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Asset Management Platforms, its third appearance after two placements as a Visionary. It says more than 13,000 brands use its platform and more than 4 million developers use its tools.

stories.title: BFSI marketers debate why customers actually stay
stories.summary: At the afaqs! BankFin 360 panel on retention and lifetime value, marketers from insurance, mutual funds, fintech, housing finance and banking discussed loyalty beyond the first transaction. Shriram Life Insurance's Rahul Adaniya said the question is no longer just how cheaply a customer is acquired.

stories.title: Dialpad expands its marketplace for integrations and partners
stories.summary: Customer experience AI platform Dialpad announced an expanded Dialpad Marketplace that brings its technology integrations and channel partner expertise into one destination. Businesses can discover integrations, including AI and agentic solutions, that fit tools and workflows they already use.

stories.title: Aurora Mobile brings Modellix.ai to ComfyUI
stories.summary: Aurora Mobile, a Nasdaq-listed marketing technology provider, made Modellix.ai, its unified AI media generation platform, available for ComfyUI. Creators and developers can use its image, video and audio models inside visual, node-based workflows by connecting an existing Modellix.ai API key.
